main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 3-bar return on forecast, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 with supporting check passing; reject if slope t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third forecast mean excess 3-bar return > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is at least 2 and the top-minus-bottom-third excess return is above 0.
reading: Cases are the bars at positions 0,3,6,... of each window with regime mean_reversion, a recorded forecast and a close 3 bars later in the same window (zero forecasts kept); the coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over the same grid on all its bars in all windows; top and bottom thirds are the n//3 highest and lowest forecasts by stable sort.
